Dear Kunene Office Supplies CC team,

Thank you for invoice IN0070697 dated 4 July 2025, referencing PO-IPAGE5PNA7. The invoice total of NAD 121157.85 is above our automatic approval limit, so it is being held for manual review.

Could you please confirm that the total is correct and matches the goods or services delivered under this purchase order? If the amount is in error, kindly send a corrected invoice referencing the same PO number.

Please note that this message does not confirm approval or a payment date. We will update you once the review is complete.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable
